say: One last thing — because a tool you can't get into isn't yours either. Type slash help and you get a curriculum, not a manual: six gestures to begin with, then the everyday verbs, then the rest of it when you're ready for it. Nothing is hidden from you; it just waits its turn. And if you'd rather be shown than told, type slash tutorial and a bee flies the whole thing with you. That's the last idea, and it's the same as the first one: this is a new way to be — so here is how to bee. The hive is yours.
